summary: Verified the JSON-LD stored-XSS fix (safeJsonLd) across all 5 affected files. Extended /app/backend/tests/security_fix_regression_test.py with a new TestJsonLdXssFix class (8 tests). Full regression suite: 23/23 PASSED, including the previously-expected-fail test_xss_in_jsonld_via_excerpt which now passes. Confirmed: (a) breakout payload '' does NOT appear raw in HTML for blog articles when injected via excerpt or keywords; it appears unicode-escaped as \u003c/script\u003e. (b) All JSON-LD
critical_code_review_comments: safeJsonLd() implementation in /app/lib/seo.ts is correct and idiomatic (escapes <, >, &, U+2028, U+2029 to \uXXXX). All 5 dangerouslySetInnerHTML JSON-LD sites now go through it: app/[slug]/page.tsx (articleSchema+breadcrumbSchema), app/layout.tsx (localBusinessSchema), app/page.tsx (faqSchema), app/layanan/[slug]/page.tsx (serviceSchema+breadcrumbSchema+faqSchema), app/portofolio/[id]/page.tsx (projectSchema). No JSON-LD dangerouslySetInnerHTML occurrences remain that use bare JSON.stringify.
seed_data_creation: 3 temporary blog posts (TEST_jsonld_xss_blog, TEST_jsonld_kw, TEST Normal Article) created and auto-deleted via teardown_class. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/security_fix_regression_test.py now has 23 tests covering: admin login, MCP token lifecycle (create/list/revoke/reactivate/delete + hermes preservation), blog markdown rendering + link renderer + body XSS sanitize + JSON-LD XSS via excerpt, JSON-LD XSS fix across all 5 pages (blog slug, homepage, layanan/[slug], portofolio/[id], root layout LocalBusiness), keywords-array XSS vector, normal article regression, blog listing render, media proxy prefix restriction, admin upload. Helper _extract_jsonlds() JSON-parses all <script type=application/ld+json> blocks per page - reuse for future SEO checks. @type can be a list (used _types_of/_all_types helpers).
rca of the issue: N/A - fix verified working. Root cause was that JSON.stringify() does not escape '</' so a user-controlled string containing '</script>' could terminate the inline JSON-LD <script> tag and inject arbitrary HTML (stored XSS). Fix: safeJsonLd() in /app/lib/seo.ts additionally escapes <, >, & and U+2028/2029 to \uXXXX unicode escapes, which are still valid JSON strings but cannot form an HTML tag.
